Sample metadata tables

Source: R/metadata.R
cmgd_sample_metadata.Rd

Reads one of the release's published sample-metadata tables (releases since cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0 / 2026-10-16), downloaded via cmgd_download() (so cached and verified) and read with duckdb:

Usage

cmgd_sample_metadata(
  rel,
  source = names(metadata_tables),
  study = NULL,
  wide = FALSE,
  cache = cmgd_cache_dir()
)

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

source

Which metadata table to read.

study

Optional study_name values to keep.

wide

FALSE for the published long table as is. TRUE for one row per sample in the samples table: study_name, sample_key, biosample, bioproject, run_accessions, then one character column per field (NA where a sample has no value; a sample with more than one distinct value for a field gets them ;-joined).

cache

Cache directory.

Value

A data.frame with attributes license (the table's licence from the manifest) and sources (the pinned rows of metadata_sources the table draws on: source, release, DOI, licence). Errors with class cmgdr_no_metadata if the release has no sample-metadata tables.

Details

  • harmonized: one value per sample and harmonized field, with the source it came from (CC-BY-4.0: it mixes in Olm-derived values).

  • cmd: curatedMetagenomicData curation, one row per field (CC0-1.0).

  • olm: the Olm lab Microbiome Repo, one row per field, with Olm's route and confidence (CC-BY-4.0).

For a CC-BY table a message gives the licence and the source DOI to cite; silence it with suppressMessages(). Joining metadata into a TreeSummarizedExperiment is left to higher-level packages.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
meta <- cmgd_sample_metadata(rel)
wide <- cmgd_sample_metadata(rel, "cmd", study = "BaiX_2021", wide = TRUE)
attr(meta, "sources")
} # }
